title: UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception
abstract: arXiv:2609.37264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. translated_title: UniAfford：面向可泛化2D-3D可供性感知的令牌路由多任务学习
translated_abstract: 可供性感知旨在定位支持具身交互的可操作区域，然而2D和3D可供性定位一直作为两个独立的问题发展，具有不同的任务定义、监督格式、数据集和评估协议。这种碎片化限制了跨视觉与几何空间的可迁移对象-可供性语义的学习。我们提出了Token Router for Tasks（任务令牌路由器），这是一种面向基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）系统的多任务训练范式，它无需语言头生成预定义标记，即可将上下文隐藏状态路由到任务特定的分支。路由后的状态由分支特定的目标直接监督，使密集预测损失能够塑造共享的MLLM表示。我们将该范式实例化为UniAfford——一个面向可泛化2D-3D可供性感知的统一框架，并配套构建了UniAfford-Data数据集，该数据集整合了像素级2D标注、点级3D标注等资源。
tldr: 提出令牌路由多任务训练范式UniAfford，通过将MLLM隐藏状态直接路由到任务特定分支并用密集预测损失监督，首次统一了原本割裂的2D与3D可供性感知任务，实现可泛化的跨模态可供性理解。
en_tdlr: UniAfford proposes a token-routed multitask training paradigm that routes MLLM hidden states to task-specific branches supervised by dense prediction losses, unifying previously separate 2D and 3D affordance perception for generalizable cross-modal affordance understanding.
